item.title: Tell How You Fixed a Tilting Picture
item.prompt_text: Tell a friend about a time you put a picture on a wall and it would not stay straight. Say what you tried first, what finally helped, and what you would check next time. You can invent the story.
item.target_grammar: Past simple for the events; first, then and next time.
item.fluency_objective: Tell the events in order. Give the first try and the successful try separate stress.
item.pronunciation_objective: Keep the final consonant in fixed and checked audible when they come before another word.

cues.text: Describe the picture and the problem.
Say what you would do next time.

item.model_opening: I put a picture of my dog on the wall last week.
item.model_answer: I put a picture of my dog on the wall last week. The frame looked straight at first, but one corner moved down every time I closed the door. First, I moved the hook a little. That did not help. Then I put a small pad behind the low corner. The picture stayed straight after that. Next time, I will check that both corners touch the wall before I finish.
